---
title: "Short headline for the entry"
description: "One- or two-sentence summary, written like a caption. Used on the news cards."
canonical-url: "https://optolab-unimore.github.io/news/items/YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug.html"
date: YYYY-MM-DD
categories: [Conference]
# Photo is optional. To add one, place the file in assets/images/ (named
# news-<slug>.jpg) and uncomment both lines below. Items without a photo render
# as text-only cards.
# image: /assets/images/news-<slug>.jpg
# image-alt: "Describe what the photo shows, for screen readers."
---

Body of the entry: a short paragraph (2–4 sentences) about the conference, talk, award or
update, linking to the related record where relevant.

Notes on using this template:

- Copy this file to `news/items/YYYY-MM-DD-short-slug.qmd` using the date of the event, so
  entries stay in chronological order both in the folder and in the listings.
- Update the title, description, date and `canonical-url` to match the new filename.
- Set `categories` (e.g. `Conference`, `Award`, `Publication`, `Seminar`) to drive the
  filters on the news archive.
- Image paths start with `/` so the same entry resolves correctly on the home page and in
  the archive.

This file is prefixed with `_`, so Quarto skips it: it never renders and never appears in
the listings. See `README.md` → "Adding a news item".
